content:
Sam: Hey @Irene @Linh — I pushed updates to https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/2457. Addressed your comments, split out the KV cache changes, added unit tests for batching edge cases. PTAL when you have a chance. Notes in PR description.
Irene: Thanks — will skim now. main thing: did you keep the old fallback policy for single-GPU runs?
Sam: Yes, kept fallback. I added a flag `enable_contiguous_batching` defaulting to true. Test covers boundary of seq_len=1024. Also added a short benchmark in ci that runs `pytest tests/batching_test.py::test_boundary` (fast).
Linh: Quick look — LGTM overall. Left one suggestion about variable name `buf` -> `buffer` (one-line). Also can you rebase on main? there are some merge conflicts in ci.yml
Sam: Good catches — renamed and rebased, force-pushed: `git push --force-with-lease origin sam/rebatch-fix`. Also removed a debug printf I left. @Irene any other blockers?
Irene: None from me. One nit: add a short comment explaining the `--warmup=10` in the benchmark command. After that I'll approve.
Sam: Added comment and pushed. Thanks! :tada:
Irene: Approving now. :white_check_mark:
qa-bot: CI passed on branch sam/rebatch-fix — all checks green.
Linh: Approving as well. Merge when ready.
